behavioral_effects: fullstack user create and UserService.register no longer log welcome_email_failed / EmailTemplateError welcome.html not found when the backend runs from a repository checkout (CI e2e job, local uv run).
EmailTemplateError details now carry a searched list of every candidate path instead of a single path.
compatibility_impact: None for callers: render_email keeps its signature and return shape. Docker/compose deployments keep working because /app/emails (the compose bind mount, resolved relative to backend/) remains a search location; repository checkouts and plain uv sync installs now resolve <repo>/emails/compiled as well.
follow_up: Consider copying emails/compiled into the backend image (or a settings-driven templates dir) so a bare docker run without compose also finds templates.
limitations: The Docker image still does not bundle emails/compiled (build context is backend/); it relies on the compose bind mount ./emails:/app/emails as before. Baking the templates into the image or adding an EMAIL_TEMPLATES_DIR setting was left out of scope.
The e2e job itself was not re-run here; the fix was verified by unit tests that fail against the old loader with the exact CI error and pass with the new one.
reason: CI e2e backend log shows welcome_email_failed EmailTemplateError welcome.html not found; templates.py resolves emails/compiled from backend/ (one directory too shallow) which only works under the compose bind mount
rollback: git revert the commit. No data, config, or migration to restore.
security_impact: None. Template lookup is still limited to two fixed in-repo directories; no user input reaches the path and the error detail lists only those searched paths.
summary: Fix email template resolution so welcome.html is found on plain uv sync installs
